138 static inline float DPC_ObjDet_quadInterpAroundPeak(const uint32_t * restrict y)
139 {
140 
141  float ym1, y0, yp1;
142  float thetapk; //, yOut;
143 
144  ym1 = (float) y[0]; /* y(peak-1) */
145  y0 = (float) y[1]; /* y(peak) */
146  yp1 = (float) y[2]; /* y(peak+1) */
147 
148  thetapk = divsp((yp1 - ym1), (2.0F * (2.0F * y0 - yp1 - ym1)));
149  /* yOut = y0 + (((yp1 - ym1) / 4) * thetapk); */
150 
151  return thetapk;
152 
153 }

176 static inline void dotpCmplxf(const float * restrict x, const float * restrict y, int nx,
177  float * restrict re, float * restrict im)
178 {
179  int i;
180  __float2_t x0_im_re, y0_im_re, result0 = 0;
181  __float2_t x1_im_re, y1_im_re, result1 = 0;
182  __float2_t x2_im_re, y2_im_re, result2 = 0;
183  __float2_t x3_im_re, y3_im_re, result3 = 0;
184  __float2_t result;
185 
186  _nassert(nx % 4 == 0);
187  _nassert(nx > 0);
188  _nassert((int)x % 8 == 0);
189  _nassert((int)y % 8 == 0);
190 
191  for(i = 0; i < 2 * nx; i += 8)
192  {
193  /* load 4 sets of input data */
194  x0_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&x[i]);
195  y0_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&y[i]);
196 
197  x1_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&x[i+2]);
198  y1_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&y[i+2]);
199 
200  x2_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&x[i+4]);
201  y2_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&y[i+4]);
202 
203  x3_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&x[i+6]);
204  y3_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&y[i+6]);
205 
206  /* calculate 4 running sums */
207  result0 = _daddsp(_complex_mpysp(x0_im_re, y0_im_re), result0);
208  result1 = _daddsp(_complex_mpysp(x1_im_re, y1_im_re), result1);
209  result2 = _daddsp(_complex_mpysp(x2_im_re, y2_im_re), result2);
210  result3 = _daddsp(_complex_mpysp(x3_im_re, y3_im_re), result3);
211  }
212 
213  result = _daddsp(_daddsp(result0,result1),_daddsp(result2,result3));
214  *re = _hif2(result);
215  *im = _lof2(result);
216 }

233 extern int32_t DPC_ObjDet_estimateXYZ(DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstCfg * restrict elevEstCfg,
234  const DetObjParams * restrict detObjList,
235  DPIF_PointCloudCartesian * restrict objOut,
236  uint32_t numObjOut,
237  uint32_t * restrict finalNumObjOut)
238 {
239  DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstCommonCfg *commonCfg = &elevEstCfg->commonCfg;
240  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *result = commonCfg->result;
241  uint8_t subFrameIdx = result->subFrameIdx;
242  DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstSubframeCfg *subframeCfg = &elevEstCfg->subframeCfg[subFrameIdx];
243  uint16_t azimFFTSize = subframeCfg->numAzimFFTBins;
244  const float invAzimFFTSize = divsp(1.0f,(float) azimFFTSize);
245  uint32_t objIdx, sampIdx, idx;
246  uint32_t maxAzimMaskWidth = 8*sizeof(commonCfg->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim);
247  uint32_t maxElevMaskWidth = 8*sizeof(commonCfg->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev);
248  int32_t currLoc;
249  float noisedB, signaldB, snrdB;
250  float peakIdxOffset, peakIdxFlt;
251  int32_t peakLoc;
252  float azimSinPhase;
253  cmplxfUnion_t DFTValAzim, DFTValElev, elevOutput;
254  float elevSinPhase, elevCosPhase;
255  float rangeStep, range, dopplerStep, x, ySquared, z;
256  float wz,peakLocFlt, peakIdxFlt_DFT;
257  int32_t dopIdx;
258  uint32_t numDopplerBins = subframeCfg->numDopplerBins;
259  int16_t ValidObjIdx;
260  double *antennaCalibParams = (double*)commonCfg->antennaCalibParams;
261 
262  /* Alignment is to be done because we use the antenna calib params for
263  * multiplication, using optimized DSP routines, which require a 8 byte alignment */
264  cmplxfImRe_t samplesCalib[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
265  cmplx32ImRe_t rearrangedAzimSamples[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
266  cmplx32ImRe_t rearrangedElevSamples[MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
267 
268  int32_t retVal = 0;
269  cmplxfImRe_t dftFactorsAzim[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
270  cmplxfImRe_t dftFactorsElev[MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
271  double * azimSamplesCalib = (double *)&samplesCalib[0];
272  double * elevSamplesCalib = (double *)&samplesCalib[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT];
273  int64_t * restrict azimSamples;
274  int64_t * restrict elevSamples;
275  double samplesFlt2;
276 
277  rangeStep = subframeCfg->rangeStep;
278  dopplerStep = subframeCfg->dopplerStep;
279 
280  /* This variable will index the final object list */
281  ValidObjIdx = 0;
282 
283  for (objIdx = 0; objIdx < numObjOut; objIdx++)
284  {
285  /* 1. Interpolate around peak to get fractional estimate of Azimuth index */
286  peakIdxOffset = DPC_ObjDet_quadInterpAroundPeak(detObjList[objIdx].azimPeakSamples);
287 
288  /* Correct peak index with the fractional index*/
289  peakIdxFlt = (float)detObjList[objIdx].azimIdx + peakIdxOffset;
290  peakIdxFlt_DFT = peakIdxFlt * (invAzimFFTSize * AOA_DFT_LEN);
291  peakLoc = ROUND_UNSIGNED(peakIdxFlt_DFT);
292 
293 
294  /* 2a. Calculate DFT Factors corresponding to wx for Row 1.
295  * i.e. calculate \f$\e^{j wx}\f$
296  */
297  idx = 0;
298  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < maxAzimMaskWidth; sampIdx ++)
299  {
300  if((commonCfg->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim >> sampIdx) & 0x1U)
301  {
302  currLoc = (peakLoc*sampIdx)%AOA_DFT_LEN;
303  dftFactorsAzim[idx++] = dftSinCosTable[currLoc];
304  }
305 
306  /* Break the loop after computing all dft factors in azimuth dimension */
307  if(idx == MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT)
308  break;
309  }
310 
311  /* 2b. Calculate DFT Factors corresponding to wx for Row 0.
312  * i.e. calculate \f$\e^{j wx}\f$
313  */
314  idx = 0;
315  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < maxElevMaskWidth; sampIdx ++)
316  {
317  if((commonCfg->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev >> sampIdx) & 0x1U)
318  {
319  currLoc = (peakLoc*sampIdx)%AOA_DFT_LEN;
320  dftFactorsElev[idx++] = dftSinCosTable[currLoc];
321  }
322 
323  /* Break the loop after computing all dft factors in elevation dimension */
324  if(idx == MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT)
325  break;
326  }
327 
328  /* 2c. Rearrange the antenna samples according to the virtual antenna mapping. */
329  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx ++)
330  {
331  rearrangedAzimSamples[sampIdx] = detObjList[objIdx].azimSamples[commonCfg->antennaGeometryCfg[sampIdx]];
332  }
333 
334  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx ++)
335  {
336  rearrangedElevSamples[sampIdx] = detObjList[objIdx].elevSamples[commonCfg->antennaGeometryCfg[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT+sampIdx]];
337  }
338 
339  azimSamples = (int64_t*) rearrangedAzimSamples;
340  elevSamples = (int64_t*) rearrangedElevSamples;
341 
342  /* 3. Azimuth Antenna Calibration:
343  * Multiply azimuth samples (azimSamples) of Doppler FFT with antenna calib params (antennaCalibParams)
344  */
345 
346  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx++)
347  {
348  samplesFlt2 = _dintsp(azimSamples[sampIdx]);
349  azimSamplesCalib[sampIdx] = _complex_mpysp(samplesFlt2,antennaCalibParams[sampIdx]);
350 
351  }
352 
353  /* 4. Elevation Antenna calibration
354  * Multiply elev samples with antenna calib params */
355  for (sampIdx = MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT ; sampIdx++ )
356  {
357  samplesFlt2 = _dintsp(elevSamples[sampIdx - MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT]);
358  elevSamplesCalib[sampIdx-MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT] = _complex_mpysp(samplesFlt2, antennaCalibParams[sampIdx]);
359  }
360 
361  /* 5. Single Bin DFT on the azimuth antennas to estimate phase at peak.
362  *
363  \f[
364  X_{azim} (\omega_x) = \sum_{k=0}^{N_{azim} - 1} azimSample(k) e^{-j k \omega_x}
365  \f]
366  * Multiply DFT factors with azimuth of Doppler FFT samples corrected for antenna calibration.
367  */
368  dotpCmplxf((float *)&azimSamplesCalib[0], (float *)&dftFactorsAzim[0], MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT, &DFTValAzim.cmplx.real, &DFTValAzim.cmplx.imag);
369 
370 
371  /* 6. Single Bin DFT on the elevation antennas to estimate phase at peak.
372  *
373  \f[
374  X_{elev} (\omega_x) = \sum_{k=0}^{N_{elev} - 1} elevSample(k) e^{-j (k+2) \omega_x}
375  \f]
376  * The elevation antennas (essentially the 4 virtual antennas corresponding to the
377  * elevation offset Tx antenna) are 4 in number and offset by 3 positions from the
378  * azimuth virtual array. Hence when the DFT is computed, begin from the 3rd DFT parameter.
379  *
380  * Both elevSamplesCalib and dftFactorsElev[4] are double-word aligned. */
381  dotpCmplxf((float *)&elevSamplesCalib[0], (float *)&dftFactorsElev[0], MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT, &DFTValElev.cmplx.real, &DFTValElev.cmplx.imag);
382 
383  /* 7. Estimate phase difference between the peak location at azimuth antennas and elevation antennas at peak.
384  * - 1. compute the conjugate product to get the phase difference (i.e. AzimVal * conj(ElevVal))
385  * - 2. _complex_conjugate_mpysp(a,b) == _complex_mpysp(conj(a), b)) */
386  elevOutput.ddat = _complex_conjugate_mpysp (DFTValElev.ddat, DFTValAzim.ddat);
387 
388 
389  /* - 2. Compute the angle of the product to estimate the phase change in elevation.
390  \f[
391  \omega_z = angle (\ X_{elev} (\omega_x)' \times X_{azim} (\omega_x) )\
392  \f]
393  */
394  if (fabsf(elevOutput.cmplx.imag) < (0.15f*fabsf(elevOutput.cmplx.real)))
395  {
396  // small angle approximation.
397  wz = divsp(elevOutput.cmplx.imag, elevOutput.cmplx.real);
398  }
399  else
400  {
401  wz = atan2sp(elevOutput.cmplx.imag, elevOutput.cmplx.real);
402  if (wz > PI_)
403  {
404  wz -= 2.0f*PI_;
405  }
406  }
407 
408  /* 8. Obtain range using the range resolution and the range Index */
409  range = rangeStep * (float)detObjList[objIdx].rangeIdx;
410 
411  /* 9. Obtain z, x coordinates.
412  \f[
413  \Phi = asin(\frac{\omega_z}{2 \pi d_z})
414  \f]
415 
416  \f[
417  z = range \times sin(\phi) = range * \frac{\omega_z}{2 \pi d_z}
418  \f]
419 
420  */
421  elevSinPhase = wz * (1.0f / (2.0f * PI_ * commonCfg->antennaSpacing.zSpacingByLambda));
422  if ((elevSinPhase > subframeCfg->aoaFovSinVal.minElevationDeg) && (elevSinPhase < subframeCfg->aoaFovSinVal.maxElevationDeg))
423  {
424 
425  z = range * elevSinPhase;
426 
427  /*
428  \f[
429  x = range cos(\phi) sin(\theta) = range /frac{\omega_x}{2 \pi d_x}
430  \f]
431 
432  */
433  peakLocFlt = peakLoc * (1.0f/ AOA_DFT_LEN);
434  if (peakLocFlt > 0.5f)
435  {
436  peakLocFlt -= 1.0f;
437  }
438 
439  x = range * peakLocFlt * (1.0f / commonCfg->antennaSpacing.xSpacingByLambda);
440 
441  /* Obtain 'square of y' coordinate
442  \f[
443  y^2 = range^2 -x^2 - z^2
444  \f]
445  */
446  ySquared = (range * range) - (z * z) - (x * x);
447 
448  /* It is possible that ySquared is less than zero (i.e. a degenerate case). In such a case ignore the object.
449  * If the case is not degenerate, proceed to check if the object is in the field of view (FoV).
450  * If so , store the newly validated object in the final object list.*/
451  if (ySquared > 0)
452  {
453  /* Estimate azimuth phase.
454  \f[
455  sin(\Theta) = \frac{x}{range \times cos(\Phi)}
456  \f]
457  */
458  elevCosPhase = sqrtsp(1 - (elevSinPhase * elevSinPhase));
459  azimSinPhase = divsp(x, (range * elevCosPhase));
460 
461  /* Check if object is in azimuth FoV, If object is in FoV, proceed to store the coordinates in the final object list */
462  if ((azimSinPhase > subframeCfg->aoaFovSinVal.minAzimuthDeg) && (azimSinPhase < subframeCfg->aoaFovSinVal.maxAzimuthDeg))
463  {
464 
465  /* Store x, y, z values */
466  objOut[ValidObjIdx].z = z;
467  objOut[ValidObjIdx].x = x;
468  objOut[ValidObjIdx].y = sqrtsp(ySquared);
469 
470  /* Obtain and store Velocity */
471  if (detObjList[objIdx].dopIdxActual > numDopplerBins / 2)
472  {
473  dopIdx = detObjList[objIdx].dopIdxActual - numDopplerBins;
474  }
475  else
476  {
477  dopIdx = detObjList[objIdx].dopIdxActual;
478  }
479  objOut[ValidObjIdx].velocity = dopIdx * dopplerStep;
480 
481  /* Calcute the side info of final detected object */
482  /* output is 20*log10(2)*value/2^(QVALUE) */
483  noisedB = 6.0 * ((float)detObjList[objIdx].dopCfarNoise) * (1.0f/(1 << QVALUE_NOISE));
484  signaldB = 6.0 * ((float)detObjList[objIdx].azimPeakSamples[1]) * (1.0f/(1<<QVALUE_SIGNAL));
485  snrdB = signaldB - noisedB;
486 
487  result->objOutSideInfo[ValidObjIdx].snr = (int)(10*snrdB);
488  result->objOutSideInfo[ValidObjIdx].noise = (int)(10*noisedB);
489 
490  /* Increment output list index */
491  ValidObjIdx++;
492  } /* End of azimuth FoV check cond */
493  } /* End of degenerate condition check */
494  } /* End of elevation FoV check cond */
495 
496  }
497  *finalNumObjOut = ValidObjIdx;
498 
499  goto exit;
500 exit:
501  return retVal;
502 }

516 void arm_cmplx_mult(
517  const int * pSrcA,
518  const float * pSrcB,
519  float * pDst,
520  uint32_t numSamples)
521 {
522  uint32_t blkCnt; /* Loop counter */
523  int a, b;
524  float c, d; /* Temporary variables to store real and imaginary values */
525 
526  /* Loop unrolling: Compute 4 outputs at a time */
527  blkCnt = numSamples >> 2U;
528 
529  while (blkCnt > 0U)
530  {
531  /* Imag: C[2 * i ] = A[2 * i] * B[2 * i + 1] + A[2 * i + 1] * B[2 * i ]. */
532  /* Real: C[2 * i + 1] = A[2 * i + 1] * B[2 * i + 1] - A[2 * i] * B[2 * i ]. */
533 
534  a = *pSrcA++;
535  b = *pSrcA++;
536  c = *pSrcB++;
537  d = *pSrcB++;
538  /* store result in destination buffer. */
539  *pDst++ = ((float)a * d) + ((float)b * c);
540  *pDst++ = ((float)b * d) - ((float)a * c);
541 
542 
543  a = *pSrcA++;
544  b = *pSrcA++;
545  c = *pSrcB++;
546  d = *pSrcB++;
547  *pDst++ = ((float)a * d) + ((float)b * c);
548  *pDst++ = ((float)b * d) - ((float)a * c);
549 
550  a = *pSrcA++;
551  b = *pSrcA++;
552  c = *pSrcB++;
553  d = *pSrcB++;
554  *pDst++ = ((float)a * d) + ((float)b * c);
555  *pDst++ = ((float)b * d) - ((float)a * c);
556 
557  a = *pSrcA++;
558  b = *pSrcA++;
559  c = *pSrcB++;
560  d = *pSrcB++;
561  *pDst++ = ((float)a * d) + ((float)b * c);
562  *pDst++ = ((float)b * d) - ((float)a * c);
563 
564  /* Decrement loop counter */
565  blkCnt--;
566  }
567 
568  /* Loop unrolling: Compute remaining outputs */
569  blkCnt = numSamples % 0x4U;
570 
571  while (blkCnt > 0U)
572  {
573  /* Imag: C[2 * i ] = A[2 * i] * B[2 * i + 1] + A[2 * i + 1] * B[2 * i ]. */
574  /* Real: C[2 * i + 1] = A[2 * i + 1] * B[2 * i + 1] - A[2 * i] * B[2 * i ]. */
575 
576  a = *pSrcA++;
577  b = *pSrcA++;
578  c = *pSrcB++;
579  d = *pSrcB++;
580 
581  /* store result in destination buffer. */
582  *pDst++ = ((float)a * d) + ((float)b * c);
583  *pDst++ = ((float)b * d) - ((float)a * c);
584  /* Decrement loop counter */
585  blkCnt--;
586  }
587 }

598 void arm_cmplx_conj_mult_cmplx_f32(
599  const float * pSrcA,
600  const float * pSrcB,
601  float * pDst,
602  uint32_t numSamples)
603 {
604  uint32_t blkCnt; /* Loop counter */
605  float a, b, c, d; /* Temporary variables to store real and imaginary values */
606 
607  /* Loop unrolling: Compute 4 outputs at a time */
608  blkCnt = numSamples >> 2U;
609 
610  while (blkCnt > 0U)
611  {
612  /* Imag: C[2 * i ] = A[2 * i + 1] * B[2 * i ] - A[2 * i] * B[2 * i + 1]. */
613  /* Real: C[2 * i + 1] = A[2 * i + 1] * B[2 * i + 1] + A[2 * i] * B[2 * i ]. */
614 
615  a = *pSrcA++;
616  b = *pSrcA++;
617  c = *pSrcB++;
618  d = *pSrcB++;
619  /* store result in destination buffer. */
620  *pDst++ = (b * c) - (a * d);
621  *pDst++ = (b * d) + (a * c);
622 
623 
624  a = *pSrcA++;
625  b = *pSrcA++;
626  c = *pSrcB++;
627  d = *pSrcB++;
628  *pDst++ = (b * c) - (a * d);
629  *pDst++ = (b * d) + (a * c);
630 
631  a = *pSrcA++;
632  b = *pSrcA++;
633  c = *pSrcB++;
634  d = *pSrcB++;
635  *pDst++ = (b * c) - (a * d);
636  *pDst++ = (b * d) + (a * c);
637 
638  a = *pSrcA++;
639  b = *pSrcA++;
640  c = *pSrcB++;
641  d = *pSrcB++;
642  *pDst++ = (b * c) - (a * d);
643  *pDst++ = (b * d) + (a * c);
644 
645  /* Decrement loop counter */
646  blkCnt--;
647  }
648 
649  /* Loop unrolling: Compute remaining outputs */
650  blkCnt = numSamples % 0x4U;
651 
652  while (blkCnt > 0U)
653  {
654  /* Imag: C[2 * i ] = A[2 * i + 1] * B[2 * i ] - A[2 * i] * B[2 * i + 1]. */
655  /* Real: C[2 * i + 1] = A[2 * i + 1] * B[2 * i + 1] + A[2 * i] * B[2 * i ]. */
656 
657  a = *pSrcA++;
658  b = *pSrcA++;
659  c = *pSrcB++;
660  d = *pSrcB++;
661 
662  /* store result in destination buffer. */
663  *pDst++ = (b * c) - (a * d);
664  *pDst++ = (b * d) + (a * c);
665  /* Decrement loop counter */
666  blkCnt--;
667  }
668 }

679 void arm_cmplx_dot_prod_f32(
680  const float * pSrcA,
681  const float * pSrcB,
682  uint32_t numSamples,
683  float * realResult,
684  float * imagResult)
685 {
686  uint32_t blkCnt; /* Loop counter */
687  float real_sum = 0.0f, imag_sum = 0.0f; /* Temporary result variables */
688  float a0,b0,c0,d0;
689 
690  /* Loop unrolling: Compute 4 outputs at a time */
691  blkCnt = numSamples >> 2U;
692 
693  while (blkCnt > 0U)
694  {
695  a0 = *pSrcA++;
696  b0 = *pSrcA++;
697  c0 = *pSrcB++;
698  d0 = *pSrcB++;
699 
700  real_sum += b0 * d0 - a0 * c0;
701  imag_sum += a0 * d0 + b0 * c0;
702 
703  a0 = *pSrcA++;
704  b0 = *pSrcA++;
705  c0 = *pSrcB++;
706  d0 = *pSrcB++;
707 
708  real_sum += b0 * d0 - a0 * c0;
709  imag_sum += a0 * d0 + b0 * c0;
710 
711  a0 = *pSrcA++;
712  b0 = *pSrcA++;
713  c0 = *pSrcB++;
714  d0 = *pSrcB++;
715 
716  real_sum += b0 * d0 - a0 * c0;
717  imag_sum += a0 * d0 + b0 * c0;
718 
719  a0 = *pSrcA++;
720  b0 = *pSrcA++;
721  c0 = *pSrcB++;
722  d0 = *pSrcB++;
723 
724  real_sum += b0 * d0 - a0 * c0;
725  imag_sum += a0 * d0 + b0 * c0;
726 
727  /* Decrement loop counter */
728  blkCnt--;
729  }
730 
731  /* Loop unrolling: Compute remaining outputs */
732  blkCnt = numSamples % 0x4U;
733 
734  while (blkCnt > 0U)
735  {
736  a0 = *pSrcA++;
737  b0 = *pSrcA++;
738  c0 = *pSrcB++;
739  d0 = *pSrcB++;
740 
741  real_sum += b0 * d0 - a0 * c0;
742  imag_sum += a0 * d0 + b0 * c0;
743 
744  /* Decrement loop counter */
745  blkCnt--;
746  }
747 
748  /* Store real and imaginary result in destination buffer. */
749  *realResult = real_sum;
750  *imagResult = imag_sum;
751 }

769 extern int32_t DPC_ObjDet_estimateXYZ(DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstCfg * restrict elevEstCfg,
770  const DetObjParams * restrict detObjList,
771  DPIF_PointCloudCartesian * restrict objOut,
772  uint32_t numObjOut,
773  uint32_t * restrict finalNumObjOut)
774 {
775  DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstCommonCfg *commonCfg = &elevEstCfg->commonCfg;
776  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *result = commonCfg->result;
777  uint8_t subFrameIdx = result->subFrameIdx;
778  DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstSubframeCfg *subframeCfg = &elevEstCfg->subframeCfg[subFrameIdx];
779  uint16_t azimFFTSize = subframeCfg->numAzimFFTBins;
780  const float invAzimFFTSize = divsp(1.0f,(float) azimFFTSize);
781  uint32_t objIdx, sampIdx, idx;
782  uint32_t maxAzimMaskWidth = 8U * (uint32_t)sizeof(commonCfg->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim);
783  uint32_t maxElevMaskWidth = 8U * (uint32_t)sizeof(commonCfg->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev);
784  int32_t currLoc;
785  float noisedB, signaldB, snrdB;
786  float peakIdxOffset, peakIdxFlt;
787  int32_t peakLoc;
788  float azimSinPhase;
789  cmplxfUnion_t DFTValAzim, DFTValElev, elevOutput;
790  float elevSinPhase, elevCosPhase;
791  float rangeStep, range, dopplerStep, x, ySquared, z;
792  float wz,peakLocFlt, peakIdxFlt_DFT;
793  int32_t dopIdx;
794  uint32_t numDopplerBins = subframeCfg->numDopplerBins;
795  uint32_t ValidObjIdx;
796  uint32_t temp;
797 
798  /* Alignment is to be done because we use the antenna calib params for
799  * multiplication, using optimized DSP routines, which require a 8 byte alignment */
800  cmplxfImRe_t samplesCalib[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
801  cmplx32ImRe_t rearrangedAzimSamples[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
802  cmplx32ImRe_t rearrangedElevSamples[MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
803 
804  int32_t retVal = 0;
805  cmplxfImRe_t dftFactorsAzim[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
806  cmplxfImRe_t dftFactorsElev[MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
807  float * azimSamplesCalib = (float *)&samplesCalib[0];
808  float * elevSamplesCalib = (float *)&samplesCalib[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT];
809 
810  rangeStep = subframeCfg->rangeStep;
811  dopplerStep = subframeCfg->dopplerStep;
812  cmplxfImRe_t *antennaCalibParams = (cmplxfImRe_t*)commonCfg->antennaCalibParams;
813 
814  /* This variable will index the final object list */
815  ValidObjIdx = 0;
816 
817  for (objIdx = 0; objIdx < numObjOut; objIdx++)
818  {
819  /* 1. Interpolate around peak to get fractional estimate of Azimuth index */
820  peakIdxOffset = DPC_ObjDet_quadInterpAroundPeak(detObjList[objIdx].azimPeakSamples);
821 
822  /* Correct peak index with the fractional index*/
823  peakIdxFlt = (float)detObjList[objIdx].azimIdx + peakIdxOffset;
824  peakIdxFlt_DFT = ROUND_UNSIGNED(peakIdxFlt * (invAzimFFTSize * (float)AOA_DFT_LEN));
825  peakLoc = (int32_t)peakIdxFlt_DFT;
826 
827 
828  /* 2a. Calculate DFT Factors corresponding to wx for Row 1.
829  * i.e. calculate \f$\e^{j wx}\f$
830  */
831  idx = 0;
832  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < maxAzimMaskWidth; sampIdx ++)
833  {
834  if(((commonCfg->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim >> sampIdx) & 0x1U) != 0U)
835  {
836  currLoc = (peakLoc * (int32_t)sampIdx) % (int32_t)AOA_DFT_LEN;
837  dftFactorsAzim[idx++] = dftSinCosTable[currLoc];
838  }
839 
840  /* Break the loop after computing all dft factors in azimuth dimension */
841  if(idx == MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT)
842  {
843  break;
844  }
845  }
846 
847  /* 2b. Calculate DFT Factors corresponding to wx for Row 0.
848  * i.e. calculate \f$\e^{j wx}\f$
849  */
850  idx = 0;
851  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < maxElevMaskWidth; sampIdx ++)
852  {
853  if(((commonCfg->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev >> sampIdx) & 0x1U) != 0U)
854  {
855  currLoc = (peakLoc * (int32_t)sampIdx) % (int32_t)AOA_DFT_LEN;
856  dftFactorsElev[idx++] = dftSinCosTable[currLoc];
857  }
858 
859  /* Break the loop after computing all dft factors in elevation dimension */
860  if(idx == MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT)
861  {
862  break;
863  }
864  }
865 
866  /* 2c. Rearrange the antenna samples according to the virtual antenna mapping. */
867  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx ++)
868  {
869  rearrangedAzimSamples[sampIdx] = detObjList[objIdx].azimSamples[commonCfg->antennaGeometryCfg[sampIdx]];
870  }
871 
872  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx ++)
873  {
874  rearrangedElevSamples[sampIdx] = detObjList[objIdx].elevSamples[commonCfg->antennaGeometryCfg[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT+sampIdx]];
875  }
876 
877  /* 3. Azimuth Antenna Calibration:
878  * Multiply azimuth samples (azimSamples) of Doppler FFT with antenna calib params (antennaCalibParams)
879  */
880  arm_cmplx_mult((int*)rearrangedAzimSamples, (float*)antennaCalibParams, (float*)azimSamplesCalib, MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT);
881 
882  /* 4. Elevation Antenna calibration
883  * Multiply elev samples with antenna calib params */
884  arm_cmplx_mult((int*)rearrangedElevSamples, (float*)&antennaCalibParams[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT], (float*)elevSamplesCalib, MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT);
885 
886  /* 5. Single Bin DFT on the azimuth antennas to estimate phase at peak.
887  *
888  \f[
889  X_{azim} (\omega_x) = \sum_{k=0}^{N_{azim} - 1} azimSample(k) e^{-j k \omega_x}
890  \f]
891  * Multiply DFT factors with azimuth of Doppler FFT samples corrected for antenna calibration.
892  */
893  arm_cmplx_dot_prod_f32((float *)&azimSamplesCalib[0], (float *)&dftFactorsAzim[0], MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT, &DFTValAzim.cmplx.real, &DFTValAzim.cmplx.imag);
894 
895 
896  /* 6. Single Bin DFT on the elevation antennas to estimate phase at peak.
897  *
898  \f[
899  X_{elev} (\omega_x) = \sum_{k=0}^{N_{elev} - 1} elevSample(k) e^{-j (k+2) \omega_x}
900  \f]
901  * The elevation antennas (essentially the 4 virtual antennas corresponding to the
902  * elevation offset Tx antenna) are 4 in number and offset by 3 positions from the
903  * azimuth virtual array. Hence when the DFT is computed, begin from the 3rd DFT parameter.
904  *
905  * Both elevSamplesCalib and dftFactorsElev[4] are double-word aligned. */
906  arm_cmplx_dot_prod_f32((float *)&elevSamplesCalib[0], (float *)&dftFactorsElev[0], MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT, &DFTValElev.cmplx.real, &DFTValElev.cmplx.imag);
907 
908  /* 7. Estimate phase difference between the peak location at azimuth antennas and elevation antennas at peak.
909  * - 1. compute the conjugate product to get the phase difference (i.e. AzimVal * conj(ElevVal)) */
910  arm_cmplx_conj_mult_cmplx_f32 ((float*)&DFTValElev.cmplx, (float*)&DFTValAzim.cmplx, (float*)&elevOutput.cmplx, 1);
911 
912 
913  /* - 2. Compute the angle of the product to estimate the phase change in elevation.
914  \f[
915  \omega_z = angle (\ X_{elev} (\omega_x)' \times X_{azim} (\omega_x) )\
916  \f]
917  */
918  if (fabsf(elevOutput.cmplx.imag) < (0.15f*fabsf(elevOutput.cmplx.real)))
919  {
920  // small angle approximation.
921  wz = divsp(elevOutput.cmplx.imag, elevOutput.cmplx.real);
922  }
923  else
924  {
925  wz = (float)atan2(elevOutput.cmplx.imag, elevOutput.cmplx.real);
926  if (wz > PI_)
927  {
928  wz -= 2.0f*PI_;
929  }
930  }
931 
932  /* 8. Obtain range using the range resolution and the range Index */
933  range = rangeStep * (float)detObjList[objIdx].rangeIdx;
934 
935  /* 9. Obtain z, x coordinates.
936  \f[
937  \Phi = asin(\frac{\omega_z}{2 \pi d_z})
938  \f]
939 
940  \f[
941  z = range \times sin(\phi) = range * \frac{\omega_z}{2 \pi d_z}
942  \f]
943 
944  */
945  elevSinPhase = wz * (1.0f / (2.0f * PI_ * commonCfg->antennaSpacing.zSpacingByLambda));
946  if ((elevSinPhase > subframeCfg->aoaFovSinVal.minElevationDeg) && (elevSinPhase < subframeCfg->aoaFovSinVal.maxElevationDeg))
947  {
948 
949  z = range * elevSinPhase;
950 
951  /*
952  \f[
953  x = range cos(\phi) sin(\theta) = range /frac{\omega_x}{2 \pi d_x}
954  \f]
955 
956  */
957  peakLocFlt = (float)peakLoc * (1.0f / (float)AOA_DFT_LEN);
958  if (peakLocFlt > 0.5f)
959  {
960  peakLocFlt -= 1.0f;
961  }
962 
963  x = range * peakLocFlt * (1.0f / commonCfg->antennaSpacing.xSpacingByLambda);
964 
965  /* Obtain 'square of y' coordinate
966  \f[
967  y^2 = range^2 -x^2 - z^2
968  \f]
969  */
970  ySquared = (range * range) - (z * z) - (x * x);
971 
972  /* It is possible that ySquared is less than zero (i.e. a degenerate case). In such a case ignore the object.
973  * If the case is not degenerate, proceed to check if the object is in the field of view (FoV).
974  * If so , store the newly validated object in the final object list.*/
975  if (ySquared > 0.0F)
976  {
977  /* Estimate azimuth phase.
978  \f[
979  sin(\Theta) = \frac{x}{range \times cos(\Phi)}
980  \f]
981  */
982  elevCosPhase = (float)sqrt(1.0 - ((double)elevSinPhase * (double)elevSinPhase));
983  azimSinPhase = divsp(x, (range * elevCosPhase));
984 
985  /* Check if object is in azimuth FoV, If object is in FoV, proceed to store the coordinates in the final object list */
986  if ((azimSinPhase > subframeCfg->aoaFovSinVal.minAzimuthDeg) && (azimSinPhase < subframeCfg->aoaFovSinVal.maxAzimuthDeg))
987  {
988 
989 
990  /* Store x, y, z values */
991  objOut[ValidObjIdx].z = z;
992  objOut[ValidObjIdx].x = x;
993  objOut[ValidObjIdx].y = (float)sqrt(ySquared);
994 
995  /* Obtain and store Velocity */
996  if (detObjList[objIdx].dopIdxActual > numDopplerBins / 2U)
997  {
998  dopIdx = (int32_t)detObjList[objIdx].dopIdxActual - (int32_t)numDopplerBins;
999  }
1000  else
1001  {
1002  dopIdx = (int32_t)detObjList[objIdx].dopIdxActual;
1003  }
1004  objOut[ValidObjIdx].velocity = (float)dopIdx * dopplerStep;
1005 
1006  /* Calcute the side info of final detected object */
1007  /* output is 20*log10(2)*value/2^(QVALUE) */
1008  temp = (uint32_t)1U << QVALUE_NOISE;
1009  noisedB = 6.0F * ((float)detObjList[objIdx].dopCfarNoise) * (1.0f/(float)(temp));
1010  temp = (uint32_t)1U << QVALUE_SIGNAL;
1011  signaldB = 6.0F * ((float)detObjList[objIdx].azimPeakSamples[1]) * (1.0f/(float)(temp));
1012  snrdB = signaldB - noisedB;
1013 
1014  result->objOutSideInfo[ValidObjIdx].snr = 10 * (int16_t)snrdB;
1015  result->objOutSideInfo[ValidObjIdx].noise = 10 * (int16_t)noisedB;
1016 
1017  /* Increment output list index */
1018  ValidObjIdx++;
1019  } /* End of azimuth FoV check cond */
1020  } /* End of degenerate condition check */
1021  } /* End of elevation FoV check cond */
1022  }
1023  *finalNumObjOut = ValidObjIdx;
1024  return retVal;
1025 }
